line: Claude Cloud exploratory analysis. Not a Research OS or Science Supervisor ruling, not an F50 closure claim.
candidate: A (spherical k-means sub-bunch, k=32, point masses, weight = count, self-cluster weight corrected to w_j-1)
dimension_per_core: 32 x (300-d centroid + 1 count) = 9632 numbers, independent of core size n
verdict: FAIL on both prospective tapes: n>=30 pooled median cos 0.808 / 0.819 (need >=0.999); n>=100 median cos 0.738 / 0.808 (need >=0.99). n10-29 passes but is a trivial/degenerate case since k=32 exceeds the bucket's core sizes (no compression actually occurs there).

other_candidates_tried.B_raw_engine_track_ids: Rejected before freeze: a river-home core's raw instantaneous group is almost always a single id -- it essentially never subdivides a core, so it is not usable as a sub-bunch scheme.
other_candidates_tried.C_centroid_plus_spread_scalar_montecarlo: Rejected before freeze: worse than A at every k tested on discovery (e.g. k=32 tape 11: cos_median 0.591 vs 0.772 for n100+); isotropic spread sampling adds uncorrelated noise rather than fixing the point-mass collapse bias.
